Map pick by StrikeForce

Demos: [https://www.quakeworld.nu/w/images/f/fb/Infinity_-fs-_vs_gb_dm3.qwz infinity (FS)]

"sf took the first quad but didnt manage to do much with it. Goh had the rl and quickly killed the quaded player. None of the teams seemed to really have much control at first . Around the 2 minute mark sf started to take control by grabbing almost every quad. This went on for the rest of the game. Goh took the occasional rl but couldnt do much with it . Near the end of the game goh looked as if they could make a comeback but sf's lead was to big by then." -Eri === DM2 === SF: 228 - GOH: 54
[[Image:2000 06 10 SF GOH dm2.jpg|320px]]
Map pick by Gods of Hellfire.

"Goh took the first quad here by making a quad bridge. Sf got control over the low rl and managed to get quad control back pretty soon. From then on it was pretty much the same story as the previous map. suicides and team kills prevented sf from taking total control but they still managed to almost lock up the map. Goh really couldnt do much about it. Near the end the same thing happened ... goh looked as if they could make a comeback but the frag difference was to big." -Eri == Summary == * Score: 2-0 * Total frags ** SF: 443 ** GOH: 126 __NOTOC__ [[Category:Matchreports]]
